note: Public repos used to measure recall. Pinned to commit SHAs. Cloned into .corpus/ by scripts/fetch-corpus.sh, never committed. The tuning set was used to find and fix detector gaps after the first run; the held-out set was labeled and measured once, after those fixes, with no further changes.
